parent_objective: implement a deterministic action-divergent candidate exporter for existing outcome artifacts
blocked_by: existing relocation runner does not apply action-divergence filters inline
invalidates: direct replay from unfiltered M1161 outcome CSV
proof conversion from candidate export alone

public_gates: M1174 may implement exporter tooling and focused tests only
M1174 must not run relocation replay
M1174 must not train actor weights
M1174 must not use private holdout
M1174 must not convert rows into a proof corpus
forbidden_shortcuts: do not convert rows into a proof corpus
do not rely on manual CSV editing

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: adds deterministic tooling to export filtered action-divergent wrong-history candidates before replay
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no replay, mining, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if exporter changes actor inputs
stop if exporter cannot preserve source diversity metadata
stop if tests cannot verify filtering, scoring, and source balancing
fallback_plan: if exporter is simple, implement as a small module with focused tests
if existing source-balance helper can be reused, avoid duplicating balancing logic
if tooling scope expands, split export implementation from run

admission_evidence: M1173 defines explicit filter, score, and diversity gates
manual CSV edits would be fragile and unreproducible
export must be separated from replay
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: exporter writes summary and candidate CSV

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If tooling cannot be kept small, split the implementation before running any replay.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level claim

hypothesis: A small deterministic exporter can create action-divergent candidate CSVs from existing outcome artifacts while preserving source-balance metadata and avoiding manual CSV editing.
success_criteria: focused tests cover filtering, scoring, source-balance caps, and summary fields
no replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: exporter scope grows beyond candidate export
replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change starts

commands.name: implement_candidate_export_tooling
commands.command: implement exporter module and focused tests

decision_rule: M1174 may only implement deterministic candidate export tooling and focused tests. It cannot run relocation replay, run mining, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or convert rows into a proof corpus.
